headline: Hearing closed on Act 250 review rules; vote held over, while landscaping and housing mix rules were discussed.
summary: A proposed rule change would let the Development Review Board review old Act 250 conditions for City Center. The final vote on it was held until the next meeting. Talks on landscaping rules, civic space, and housing mix took up much of the session.
decisions: Closed the public hearing on LDR 2611 by a 5-0 vote.
Held the vote on LDR 2611 until the next meeting.
discussion: Act 250 review rules: Discussion covered how old conditions would be reviewed and whether staff could screen out some of them before the board reviews the rest.
Landscaping budget: Views varied on replacing the construction-cost formula with lot size, building footprint, or employee count, and on capping spending on art and hardscaping.
Civic space rules: Talk centered on lowering the civic space requirement for commercial areas from 10% to 5% and on when that space must be built.
Housing mix and long-term care: Discussion covered how to allow long-term care in the MSN district, how to require a mix of housing types, and whether to allow small efficiency apartments.
Commercial building size: Staff proposed measuring commercial size limits by building footprint rather than total floor area, and lowering the medium-scale limit.

decision_evidence.quote: So I move to close the public hearing. Second. On L- on LD 26-11. Yep. You can call the vote. So any All in favor? ... Okay, that's all five unanimous.
